rules.verified_fact: Touchdown = 6 pts; Field Goal = 3 pts; Safety = 2 pts; Try = 1 pt (kick or safety) or 2 pts (touchdown).
rules.modeling_impact: Creates discrete margin clustering at 3, 6, 7, 10, 14 pts; continuous normal approximations misprice push rates at key numbers.

rules.verified_fact: Modifies alignment requirements for receiving team players in the setup zone on a kickoff/safety kick (6-1-3) and modifies the dead ball spot after a touchback when the kickoff is from the 50-yard line (6-1-5).
rules.modeling_impact: Changes average drive starting field position and expected points per drive; pre-2025/2026 historical totals priors must be recalibrated.

rules.verified_fact: Permits the kicking team to declare an onside kick at any time during the game.
rules.modeling_impact: Alters trailing-team comeback variance and late-game spread cover tail probabilities compared to fourth-quarter-only declaration rules.

rules.verified_fact: Permits League personnel to consult with on-field officials when considering potential disqualification of a player for both flagrant football and non-football acts, even if not called on the field.
rules.modeling_impact: Increases mid-game ejection exposure forcing sudden 2nd/3rd-string replacements without injury warning.

rules.rule_ref: CBA & NFL Roster Rules — Gameday Active List (48 / 47 Rule)
rules.verified_fact: Maximum gameday Active List is 48 players ONLY if the team has a minimum of 8 active offensive linemen (primary position C, G, or OT); if fewer than 8 OL are active, maximum gameday roster drops to 47.
rules.modeling_impact: Forces clubs to dress at least 3 backup OL (8 total OL for 5 starting spots), directly governing 2nd/3rd-string OL availability on gameday.
rules.source_label: NFL Football Operations — Roster Sizes & Contract Language (2026)

rules.verified_fact: Active/Inactive List is 53 players, expandable to 54 or 55 for one week by elevating 1 or 2 Practice Squad players (16-player PS, or 17 with an International Player Pathway player in 2026). Max 3 regular-season elevations per PS player per League Year before requiring a 53-man contract.
rules.modeling_impact: Saturday afternoon Practice Squad elevations are a high-signal indicator that a Questionable/DNP starter or 2nd-string backup will not play or is on snap count.
rules.source_label: NFL Football Operations — Standard Elevation Addendum (2026)

rules.rule_ref: Official NFL Injury Report Scale (Practice & Game Status)
rules.verified_fact: Practice Statuses: Did Not Participate In Practice (DNP), Limited Participation in Practice (LP), Full Participation in Practice (FP). Game Statuses: Out, Doubtful, Questionable.
rules.modeling_impact: Players on Injured Reserve (minimum 4 games missed) do NOT appear on the weekly active-roster practice report — models must join IR transactions with weekly injury reports.

rules.rule_ref: On-Field Injury Detection — Independent ATC Spotters
rules.verified_fact: League assigns two independently certified athletic trainers (AT spotters) per game monitoring broadcast video; player evaluations after medical timeout must last at least one play unless team takes a timeout, period ends, two-minute warning occurs, or foul caused injury.
rules.modeling_impact: Mandatory removal windows create abrupt mid-drive backup snaps (especially QB2, backup C, and backup Green-Dot LB).
rules.source_label: NFL Football Operations — AT Spotters & Concussion Protocol
